help_getting_started_body:
1. Create an account or sign in (Account). Confirm your e-mail if asked.
2. Import your resume (Profiles) and confirm only the facts that are accurate — only confirmed facts are ever presented as your experience. Optionally complete your interview profile (hobbies, motivation, goals).
3. Add the interview (Interviews): job title, company and the job description, then press Prepare (it saves the interview first).
4. Run the Pre-interview check, then Open Live Assistant.
help_before_body:
• Join the call in Chrome, Meet, Zoom or Teams and play a short sound: the meter in the Live Assistant should move.
• In Settings, choose the playback device (headset or speakers) you hear the interviewer on.
• Run the Pre-interview check (shield icon). Fix anything marked FAIL; warnings are optional.
• Use the assistant only where assistance is permitted.
help_controls_body:
Start listening / Pause — Ctrl+Alt+L. Paused time uses no live minutes.
Type a question — Ctrl+Alt+Q (works while paused, uses no live minutes).
Show / hide the window — Ctrl+Alt+Space.   Coach mode (keywords) — Ctrl+Alt+C.
Shorter, Technical, Example, Full answer and Regenerate rework the answer you are looking at — the question and its place in the history stay the same. ‹ › browse earlier questions.
Your microphone is never captured — only the audio you hear from the interviewer.
help_audio_body:
• "No interview audio" — the meeting plays on a different device. Pick it in Settings, or set it as the Windows default playback device.
• The meter moves but nothing is transcribed — check your internet connection and run Test transcription in the Pre-interview check.
• Bluetooth headsets: use the "Headphones"/"Stereo" output, not "Hands-Free".
• Silence between questions is normal: the status shows "Listening · quiet".
• Notification sounds, beeps and remarks between interviewers are ignored — they are not answered.
help_honesty_body: The assistant presents only facts you confirmed as your experience. When the interviewer asks whether you personally did something your profile does not show, the answer starts with an honest bridge and then explains how you would approach it. Personal questions (hobbies, motivation) use only what you wrote in your interview profile.
